# `spell-vfx-template` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "spell-vfx-template" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/spell-vfx-template/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Template id, e.g. "svt-area-rune-ring". |
| `notes` | string | required | What the template shows and where it suits, for review. |
| `tint` | string | `"#FFFFFF"` | Default tint: particle colours are recoloured to it, keeping their brightness. |
| `scale` | number 0.1–10 | `1` | Default size multiplier (particle size, speed and spawn radius, or ring/beam detail). |

An entry is exactly one of the objects below: the fields above, plus those of its option.

## 1. Plays on the caster while the spell charges.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `"castWindup"` | required |  |
| `effect` | ref → vfx-effect | required | The `vfx-effect` it plays (recoloured by the tint). |

## 2. Plays on the caster the moment the spell leaves.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `"castRelease"` | required |  |
| `effect` | ref → vfx-effect | required | The `vfx-effect` it plays (recoloured by the tint). |

## 3. A head that rides the bolt and an optional trail.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `"projectile"` | required |  |
| `head` | ref → vfx-effect | required | Rides the projectile for its whole flight (a looping effect). |
| `trail` | ref → vfx-effect | — | Follows the projectile (a looping effect); optional. |

## 4. Plays where the spell lands, turned to the surface.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `"impact"` | required |  |
| `effect` | ref → vfx-effect | required | The `vfx-effect` it plays (recoloured by the tint). |

## 5. A rune ring (and optional motes) sized to the spell radius.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `"area"` | required |  |
| `ring` | object | required | The rune ring from the magical material library, laid flat on the ground: its plane reaches exactly the spell radius. |
| `ring.intensity` | number 0–4 | `1` | Glow strength of the rune ring (magical materials intensity). |
| `ring.spin` | number ≥ 0 | `0.04` | Turns per second; 0 holds it still. |
| `ring.growSeconds` | number ≥ 0 | required | The ring expands from its centre to the radius over this long. |
| `ring.pulseHz` | number 0–2 | `0` | Brightness pulses this many times a second, at most 2 (photosensitivity); 0 = steady. Reduced motion holds it steady. |
| `effect` | ref → vfx-effect | — | Motes played at the centre, scaled with the radius (a looping effect). |

## 6. A beam between a start socket and an end point, with a width.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `"beam"` | required |  |
| `beam` | object | required | The beam strip between its start and end sockets. |
| `beam.width` | number > 0 | required | Beam width in metres. |
| `beam.alpha` | number 0–1 | required | Peak opacity of the beam core. |
| `beam.scrollSpeed` | number ≥ 0 | required | How fast the energy streams along the beam, in lengths per second. |
| `beam.pulseHz` | number 0–2 | `0` | Brightness pulses this many times a second, at most 2 (photosensitivity); 0 = steady. Reduced motion holds it steady. |
| `endEffect` | ref → vfx-effect | — | Plays where the beam ends (a looping effect); optional. |

## 7. A looping effect on the target while a status or channel holds.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `"sustainOnTarget"` | required |  |
| `effect` | ref → vfx-effect | required | The `vfx-effect` it plays (recoloured by the tint). |

## 8. Arrival and departure of a summoned thing.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `"summon"` | required |  |
| `effect` | ref → vfx-effect | required | Plays where the summoned thing arrives or leaves. |
| `dissolveSeconds` | number > 0 | required | How long its body takes to dissolve in (or out), magical materials dissolve. |
